Subject: Request for a Quieter Meeting Room

Hi Facilities Team,

I hope you’re well. I’m writing to request a quieter meeting room for our [one-time/recurring] meetings. Our current space (Room [number/name]) has been affected by noise from [hallway/construction/adjacent offices], which makes it difficult to concentrate and take calls.

Could you please assign or recommend an alternative room that is more sound-insulated or located away from heavy foot traffic? Ideally the room would seat about [number] people and include [AV/equipment needs, if any]. Our usual meeting time is [day(s) and time]; if that slot isn’t available, we’re flexible and can provide specific dates.

Thanks very much for your help — please let me know what options are available or if you need any additional details.

Best regards,
[Your Name]
[Your Job Title / Department]
[Phone or Email]
